我和新出生小宝宝的故事
Big Brother Now
A Story About Me and Our New Baby
[美] 安妮特·谢尔登（Annette Sheldon） 著
[美] 凯伦·麦泽尔（Karen Maizel） 绘
赵丹 译
美国心理学会
官方授权
APA

[P2] 儿童情绪管理与性格培养绘本
我当大哥哥了
我和新出生小宝宝的故事
Big Brother Now
A Story About Me and Our New Baby
[美] 安妮特·谢尔登（Annette Sheldon）著
[美] 凯伦·麦泽尔（Karen Maizel）绘
赵丹 译
化学工业出版社
·北京·

[P3] 以前，每个人见了
我都会说：“你真是个
棒小伙儿！”我喜欢听
这样的话，这让我感觉
温暖、安全和强壮。

[P4] 但是现在，我有了一个小妹妹。
她的名字叫艾比。
每个人都来看她，发出咕咕的声音逗她，还给她带来了礼物。
当然，有时也会送给我。房间里堆满了粉色的东西。
现在，所有人见了我都会说：‘杰克，你真是个了不起的大哥哥！’可是，我还不知道怎么当一个大哥哥。

[P5] 爷爷就住在隔壁。以前，每当他的自行车店打烊后，他都会给我打电话：“我的冠军今天过得好吗？”但是现在，他每天下班回家路过时都会进来看看，一进门就问，“我的小宝贝艾比今天好吗？我的冠军在哪儿？”

[P6] 一切都和以前不一样了。那天，我让妈妈帮我拿零食，妈妈说：“我很快就去帮你拿，杰克。不过我得先喂完艾比，她太小了，还不会等待。”于是，我只能等着。

我洗了苹果。

但是，妈妈还在忙着给艾比喂奶。
我准备好切苹果器。
对了，我们还需要一张纸巾。

[P7] 当艾比喝饱了，妈妈帮我切开了苹果，然后对我说：‘杰克，你耐心地等了这么长时间，真是个非常棒的大哥哥！我知道这么做有时很难，但是在等待的时候把一切都准备好确实是个好主意。’我喜欢妈妈这么说。

[P8] 一天，外面刮起了大风，天冷得没法出去玩。
以前，遇到这样的天气，妈妈和我通常会待在家里看书。
但是，艾比又哭闹起来，她哭得非常厉害。我等着妈妈给我读一本书，可是她抱着艾比在屋里走来走去，嘴里还一直发出“呜——嘘，呜——嘘”的声音。

[P9] 我问妈妈她为什么要发出这种声音。她说
那听起来像她的心跳声。艾比在妈妈肚子里听
到的就是这种声音，所以这会让她感觉好些。

但是，这并不管用。

[P10] 妈妈抱着艾比不停地走啊走啊，艾比哭了很长时间。她哭得脸都红了，还打起了嗝。最后，我也跟在妈妈身后一起走。

我试着给她哼了一首曲子。

妈妈也帮我一起哼唱，但是我觉得艾比根本就听不见。

最后，艾比终于睡着了。妈妈把她放在小床上，然后一下子坐在了沙发上说道：“对不起，杰克，我简直太累了，我现在不能给你讲故事了。来！坐在我身边，让我休息几分钟，然后我们来读那本书。”

[P11] 妈妈休息时，
我就自己看书，书
里有消防英雄。

然后，我玩了一会儿我的玩具消防车，我
还把它的警笛关了。

[P12] 每周五，妈妈都会带我参加图书馆的故事会活动。艾比也和我们一起去，但是她还太小了，不能和我们一起去听故事。

每周六，爸爸和我负责照看艾比。这样，妈妈就可以出去和苏阿姨、姥姥一起吃午饭。当艾比饿了，她想马上喝奶，于是我们就得赶紧去拿她的奶瓶。

要是艾比的奶洒在地上，我就帮爸爸把它擦干净，我们的猫Momo也非常乐意帮这个忙。爸爸从冰箱里又拿出了一些奶，然后对我说：“杰克，谢谢你的帮忙，你越来越像个大哥哥了。”

[P13] 当我从艾比的房间出来时，爸爸就站在门口。
他跟我击掌庆祝，我们还跳起了神秘的野人舞。
当艾比哭闹时，我就把手伸进她的小床，轻轻地拍她，还对她说：“呜——嘘，呜——嘘，别怕，哥哥在这呢。”她睁开眼睛，看了我好长时间。然后，她冲我笑了一下，又睡着了。成功了！现在，我真的感觉像个大哥哥了！

[P14] 今天早上，爷爷打来电话，这次他问了艾比之后还和我通了话。他需要一个大孩子去他的自行车店帮点小忙。他说，我们可以在那儿擦洗我的自行车，还可以给它安个车铃。

艾比还不能去和爷爷一起玩，因为她还是个小宝宝。

[P15] 但是，我
已经长大了，
所以我能和爷爷一起去。

我又感到了温暖、安全和强壮。

[P2] Children's Emotional Management and Character Development Picture Book
I'm the Big Brother Now
A Story About Me and Our New Baby
Big Brother Now
A Story About Me and Our New Baby
[USA] Annette Sheldon (Annette Sheldon) Author
[USA] Karen Maizel (Karen Maizel) Illustrator
Translated by Zhao Dan
Chemical Industry Press
·Beijing·

[P3] Before, everyone who saw me would say, “You’re such a great kid!” I liked hearing that. It made me feel warm, safe, and strong.

[P4] But now, I have a little sister.
Her name is Abby.
Everyone comes to see her, cooing and bringing her gifts.
Of course, sometimes they bring gifts for me too. The room is filled with pink things.
Now, everyone who sees me says, 'Jack, you're such an amazing big brother!' But I still don't know how to be a big brother.

[P5] Grandpa lives next door. Before, after his bike shop closed, he would call me: “How’s my champion today?” But now, every day after work, when he passes by, he comes in to see, and as soon as he enters, he asks, “How’s my little baby Abby today? Where’s my champion?”

[P6] Everything is different now. That day, I asked Mom to get me a snack. Mom said, "I'll get it for you right away, Jack. But I have to finish feeding Abby first. She's too little to wait." So, I just had to wait.

I washed the apple.

But Mom was still busy feeding Abby.
I got out the apple slicer.
Oh, and we need a paper towel, too.

[P7] When Abby finished her bottle, Mom helped me cut open the apple, and then said to me: 'Jack, you waited so patiently for such a long time. You're such a wonderful big brother! I know it's hard sometimes, but it's a good idea to get everything ready while you're waiting.' I like it when Mom says that.

[P8] One day, a strong wind blew outside, and it was too cold to go out to play.
In the past, on such days, Mom and I would usually stay home and read books.
But then, Abby started crying again, and she was crying very hard. I was waiting for Mom to read me a book, but she was holding Abby and walking back and forth in the room, making a constant “oooh-shh, oooh-shh” sound.

[P9] I asked Mommy why she was making that sound. She said
it sounded like her heartbeat. Abby heard that sound in Mommy's tummy,
so it would help her feel better.

But, it didn't work.

[P10] Mom held Abby and walked back and forth, back and forth. Abby cried for a long time. Her face turned red, and she started hiccupping. Finally, I walked behind Mom too.

I tried humming a little song for her.

Mom also hummed with me, but I felt like Abby just couldn’t hear us.

Finally, Abby fell asleep. Mom put her in her little bed, then sat down on the sofa and said, “Sorry, Jack, I’m just so tired. I can’t read you a story right now. Come on! Sit beside me, let me rest for a few minutes, and then we’ll read that book.”

[P11] When Mom rested,
I read a book by myself. It had fire heroes in it.

Then, I played with my toy fire truck for a while. I
also turned off its siren.

[P12] Every Friday, Mom takes me to the library's story time. Abby goes with us too, but she's still too little to sit and listen to the stories.

Every Saturday, Dad and I are in charge of looking after Abby. That way, Mom can go out to have lunch with Aunt Sue and Grandma. When Abby gets hungry and wants to drink milk right away, we have to rush to get her bottle.

If Abby spills her milk on the floor, I help Dad wipe it up, and our cat Momo is also happy to help. Dad takes out more milk from the fridge and then says to me, 'Jack, thank you for helping. You're becoming more and more like a big brother.'

[P13] When I came out of Abby's room, Dad was standing at the door.
He gave me a high-five to celebrate, and we even danced a mysterious caveman dance.
When Abby was crying, I reached my hand into her crib, gently patted her, and said to her, "Shh—shh, shh—shh, don't be afraid, big brother is here." She opened her eyes, looked at me for a long time. Then, she smiled at me once, and fell back asleep. Success! Now, I really feel like a big brother!

[P14] This morning, Grandpa called. This time, after asking about Abby, he talked to me. He needed a big kid to help out at his bike shop. He said we could wash my bike there and even put a bell on it.

Abby can't go play with Grandpa yet, because she's still a little baby.

[P15] But, I
have grown up,
so I can go with Grandpa.

I felt warm, safe, and strong again.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《我当大哥哥了》，讲述一个男孩成为新出生小宝宝的大哥哥的故事，作者为安妮特·谢尔登，绘者为凯伦·麦泽尔，由化学工业出版社出版，并获得美国心理学会官方授权。
[P2] 本页为绘本的扉页，展示了书名《我当大哥哥了》、副标题、作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息，并配有书本、苹果和消防帽的插图。
[P3] 画面中，一个戴着消防帽的男孩正抱着一个婴儿，旁边站着一位微笑的女性，背景是秋日的房屋和树木。文字描述了男孩过去被称赞为“棒小伙儿”时的感受，表达了他曾经的自信与安全感。
[P4] 本页讲述了主人公杰克有了一个叫艾比的小妹妹，大家都来探望并送礼物，房间堆满粉色物品，所有人都称赞他是了不起的大哥哥，但他自己却还不知道如何当好大哥哥。
[P5] 爷爷每天下班后都会来探望新生儿艾比，并询问杰克的情况，表现出对新家庭成员的关心和对杰克的爱。
[P6] 杰克想让妈妈帮他拿零食，但妈妈因要喂妹妹艾比而无法立即帮忙，杰克只能等待。他于是自己洗了苹果，并准备切苹果器和纸巾，试图帮忙做些事情。
[P7] 妈妈帮杰克切开苹果，并称赞他耐心等待、准备充分，是个很棒的大哥哥，杰克对此感到开心。
[P8] 外面刮起大风，杰克和妈妈本想待在家里看书，但妹妹艾比突然哭闹起来，妈妈抱着她来回走动并发出安抚的声音，杰克的阅读计划被打断。
[P9] 杰克询问妈妈为何发出类似心跳的声音来安抚妹妹艾比，妈妈解释这是为了让艾比感觉舒适，但这种方法并未奏效。
[P10] 妹妹艾比哭闹不止，妈妈抱着她来回走动并哼唱安抚，杰克也尝试帮忙哼歌，但艾比似乎没有反应。最终艾比睡着后，妈妈因疲惫无法立即讲故事，邀请杰克坐下休息片刻，再一起读书。
[P11] 妈妈休息时，杰克自己看书，书里有消防英雄；之后他玩了一会儿玩具消防车，并关掉了它的警笛。
[P12] 本页描绘了杰克和爸爸在厨房照顾妹妹艾比的场景，爸爸从冰箱取奶，杰克在擦地，猫Momo也在帮忙。文字讲述了家庭分工：妈妈带杰克去图书馆，爸爸和杰克负责照看艾比，杰克因帮忙擦地而被爸爸称赞为越来越像大哥哥。
[P13] 杰克成功安抚了哭闹的妹妹艾比，她冲他笑了笑后又睡着了，杰克感到自己像个大哥哥。爸爸在门口迎接他，两人击掌庆祝并跳起了野人舞。
[P14] 杰克接到爷爷的电话，得知爷爷需要他帮忙去自行车店擦洗自行车并安装车铃，但妹妹艾比还太小，不能一起去。画面中，杰克在打电话，爷爷在窗外挥手，另一幅图中杰克亲吻着婴儿车里的艾比。
[P15] 杰克告诉爷爷自己已经长大，可以和他一起去自行车店；同时，妈妈和爸爸在门廊上拥抱杰克，他感到温暖、安全和强壮。
[P16] 画面中，妈妈抱着婴儿艾比，杰克穿着消防员服装站在一旁，三人亲密互动，表现出家庭的温暖与关爱。
